name: Mupsi Shacklefridd
summary: Outside Ratchet in the Barrens, Mupsi Shacklefridd helps travelers mend their ties with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

sections.title: On the Outskirts of Ratchet
sections.body: Along the coastal road outside Ratchet, Mupsi Shacklefridd helps travelers regain favor with the Steamwheedle Cartel. Steamwheedle guards patrol the edge of the port town as merchants come and go. If the goblins have turned against you, Mupsi offers a way back into their good graces, provided you bring the supplies and labor they demand.

faq.answer: Mupsi Shacklefridd is a goblin stationed just outside Ratchet in the Barrens. She helps travelers restore their standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel.
You can find Mupsi just outside Ratchet in the Barrens, where port guards and patrols sometimes pass by.

faq.q: Why would someone talk to Mupsi Shacklefridd?
faq.answer: If you have angered the Steamwheedle Cartel, Mupsi can help you repair your standing with supplies. This often follows trouble with goblins or siding with pirates.
